dossier.identity: wall-raising bastion who answers every projectile with a gel barrier that she can grow, share and wrap around the whole squad~
dossier.selectionRationale: bastion because the shield cannon turns projectiles into time: a self barrier that scales to allies, a projectile wall and a barrier that restores itself. distinct from aegis's reflect-wall and iris's rampart by being built around barrier upkeep rather than reflection. gel walls are the kit's deployed constructs, so calyx has wall entities although the weapon label is a cannon. hypothesis kit (owner decision 2026-11-07).
dossier.weaponConcept: shield cannon (high-output barrier projector firing condensed ceramic slugs and deploying modular gel barriers, with a shield projector disc, gel coolant channel, power core for barrier generation, ceramic barrel, quick-release armor plates and a recoil stabilizer frame)

lore.backstory: a flood-wall engineer from the lower districts who built barrier gel for a living and watched the owners sell the walls out from under the neighbourhood. she kept the cannon and the recipe and now raises the walls herself, one block at a time, for anyone standing behind them~
lore.syndicateRecord: wanted for unlicensed gel construction across four evacuation corridors and for refusing a demolition order from a tower with people still inside.
lore.psychProfile: calm, strong and fond of carrying other people's weight; measures a fight by how many people are still standing behind her at the end.
lore.combatQuote: “walls keep more than danger out, darling. stand behind mine and let the loud ones work themselves tired.”

iconFamily.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: one base raster concept for a game ability icon, to be traced into SVG. Character: Calyx. Theme: gel bulwark. Subject: a bold flower calyx shield enclosing a single chunky gel droplet. Centered compact square silhouette, fills 82% of canvas. Flat solid black monochromatic ink on genuinely transparent background. Exceptionally bold clean outer contour, broad shapes and large negative-space gaps. Recognizable at 24 to 30 pixels. No tiny details, thin lines, text, badges, borders, HUD elements, colored accents, gradients, shadows, textures or 3D. ONE original base emblem, not a sheet or variants. All four subsequent ability variations must keep this same identifiable theme.
iconFamily.method: built-in image generation, then silhouette tracing, then four SVG variations
